title: Flag M2 Immunoprecipitation and Western Blot in Drosophila
author: Caroline Grabbe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jivcke6

steps.title: Harvest embryos and wash
steps.instruction: Collect 0–22 h Drosophila embryos in a mesh basket, wash away yeast paste with deionized H₂O.

steps.title: Dechorionate embryos
steps.instruction: Incubate embryos in a 1:1 mixture of 14 % sodium hypochlorite (f.c. 7 %) and deionized H₂O for 2–4 min, then rinse in deionized water for 1 min.

steps.title: Lyse embryos in Buffer A
steps.instruction: Transfer embryos to 1.5 mL tubes in 100 µL portions, mince with a pestle in 200 µL Lysis Buffer A (50 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM EGTA, 1 % Triton X‑100, 10 % glycerol, 25 mM N‑ethylmaleimide (NAF), 10 µM ZnCl₂) supplemented with 1 tablet Roche Complete Inhibitors per 50 mL, 1 mM PMSF and 10 mM N‑ethyl‑maleimide. Add 800 µL fresh Lysis Buffer A, grind further, incubate on ice 30 min, spin 14 000 × g 15 min at 4 °C, and pool supernatant.

steps.title: Quantify embryo protein
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration of the pooled embryo lysate.

steps.title: Harvest and wash larvae
steps.instruction: Collect wandering third‑instar larvae, rinse twice in 1× PBS.

steps.title: Lyse larvae in Buffer A
steps.instruction: Place 25 larvae in a 1.5 mL tube with 125 µL Lysis Buffer A, grind with pestle, add 375 µL fresh Lysis Buffer A, continue grinding, incubate on ice 30 min, spin 14 000 × g 15 min at 4 °C, and pool supernatant.

steps.title: Quantify larval protein
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration of the pooled larval lysate.

steps.title: Harvest and anesthetize adults
steps.instruction: Collect 0–4‑day‑old adult flies under CO₂ anesthesia, 40 flies per 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Lyse adult flies in Buffer A
steps.instruction: Grind flies in 200 µL Lysis Buffer A, add another 200 µL Lysis Buffer A, continue grinding, incubate on ice 30 min, spin 14 000 × g 15 min at 4 °C, and pool supernatant.

steps.title: Quantify adult protein
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration of the pooled adult lysate.

steps.title: Prepare input sample
steps.instruction: Mix 60 µL of any lysate with 60 µL 2× Sample buffer, incubate 7 min at 98 °C; keep as INPUT control.

steps.title: Prepare Flag M2 beads
steps.instruction: Defrost Flag M2 magnetic beads (Sigma M8823), aliquot slurry with a cut pipet tip, wash beads 3 times in Lysis Buffer A, and collect with a magnetic separator.

steps.title: Set up Flag immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube, combine 1–2 mg total protein with 30 µL Flag M2 bead slurry (≈15 µL packed beads), incubate 2 h at 4 °C on a rotator.

steps.title: Wash immunoprecipitated beads
steps.instruction: Collect beads with magnetic separator and wash 6 times with 1 mL Lysis Buffer A, separating beads between washes.

steps.title: Elute bound proteins
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL 2× Sample buffer containing ≤5 % β‑mercaptoethanol to beads, heat 98 °C for 4 min (alternatively elute with 0.1 M Glycine‑HCl, pH 3.0).

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Separate beads magnetically, transfer eluated proteins to fresh tubes using a narrow‑ended tip.

steps.title: Separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load eluates and INPUT samples onto SDS‑PAGE gels (choose acrylamide % or gradient appropriate for target protein) and run electrophoresis.

steps.title: Transfer to PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins onto a 0.2 mm PVDF membrane (Merck Millipore) using a semi‑dry Trans‑Blot Turbo system (Bio‑Rad).

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane in 5 % BSA in 1× TBS (50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl) for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibody in 1× TBS with 5 % BSA, incubate membrane overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash membrane first time
steps.instruction: Wash membrane 5 × 10 min in TBST (1× TBS + 0.075 % Tween‑20).

steps.title: Incubate with HRP secondary
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane with HRP‑linked secondary antibody (GE Healthcare) for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash membrane second time
steps.instruction: Wash membrane 5 × 10 min in TBST at room temperature, then wash 10 min in 1× TBS.

steps.title: Develop and visualize blot
steps.instruction: Develop using either SuperSignal™ West Pico (Thermo) or ECL™ Prime (GE Healthcare) chemiluminescent substrate, and detect signal by autoradiography on film or with a C‑Digit Blot Scanner (LI‑COR).
